description: This source file contains the code-behind logic for the 'TheoryExam' web page of an online examination system. It manages loading questions from a database, displaying them to the user, handling answer submissions, and managing session-based timing and navigation.

classes.name: TheoryExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the TheoryExam ASP.NET page, handling page events, database interactions for questions and answer submissions, and session management.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles initial page load, loads questions from database, displays them, and sets the exam timer based on the retrieved 'eTime' value.

methods.name: getCourseName
methods.description: Returns the full course name given its course ID.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the user profile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the leaderboard page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Stores the user's answers into the database, updates various related tables, and finalizes the exam submission.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles user logout and navigation to login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Updates the remaining exam time display and detects when time has expired.
